svg.title: The worked relativity example
svg.desc: The head dimension is 4: the diagram shows the two pair angles, the rotated vectors, and three position pairs with one difference yielding one logit.
svg.text: Relativity in numbers (worked example): dhead = 4, Δ = 2

svg.text: pair norms unchanged — a rotation is a rotation

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: |Δ| under 1e-12: shifting both positions is invisible

g.text: Why: <Rₘq, Rₙk> = qᵀRₘᵀRₙk = qᵀRₙ₋ₘk — the absolute positions cancel identically.
The fast pair (θ₀ = 1) covered nearly half a turn at m = 3; the slow one (θ₁ = 0.01) — a mere 0.03 rad:
the position is written in "digits" of different granularity — the same principle as Vaswani's sinusoids.
course verification pins the example with an assert over hundreds of random position triples (tolerance 1e-10)
